notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.
505 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Give a named item its name
decisions.why: 3 paragraphs set out a term and its definition — "Self Awareness- Able to recognize ones emotions…" — with the term in the same weight as the definition, so a series of named things reads as a run of prose. The term takes the weight. No word moves and the order does not change.
